name: Whispering Fiddlehead Grove
description: A grove of giant fiddlehead ferns curls into elegant spirals, glowing with soft spores in the morning mist.
prompt: A single enchanting fantasy scene of a grove of giant fiddlehead ferns curling into elegant spirals, their tips glowing with soft green spores. Tiny deer and glowing insects wander between the fern stems, mist drifting low. Early morning light, deep emerald and gold palette, magical forest atmosphere, high detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: A forest of spirals that seem to whisper as they unfurl. Can you hear the fiddlehead grove?
